items.description: Planomy is a free, local-first US personal-finance and retirement planner whose browser tools model year-by-year cash flow, federal/state tax, Social Security, Medicare/IRMAA, RMDs, Roth conversions, Monte Carlo and historical returns, with no account required
Planomy is educational planning software, not financial, tax or investment advice
The core planner and all calculators are free; plan data stays on the user's device unless the user opts into an account and cloud sync (paid Plus tier exists)
Retirement planner web app for building a detailed US retirement plan in the browser
Pricing page comparing Free and Plus features with monthly and annual prices
Home/overview page explaining what the planner models and how local-first storage works
37 free, no-sign-up financial calculators (401(k) match, state 529 plans, RMD, Roth conversion, Social Security, IRMAA, take-home pay, etc.)
37 plain-English guides on retirement, tax and personal-finance questions (RMD rules, safe withdrawal rate, Social Security timing, backdoor Roth, etc.)
Comparison guides of Planomy versus competing planners (Boldin, Empower, ProjectionLab)
2026 retirement and tax data page with dated, source-attributed IRS, SSA and CMS figures
Machine-readable 2026 US federal tax, contribution limit, Social Security, Medicare and RMD figures in JSON with source metadata
Manifest JSON listing available versioned tax-data years
llms-full.txt containing the full text of all guides and calculators with canonical URLs
RSS feed of all published guides
Privacy policy describing what is stored locally, what optional cloud sync changes, and third-party services
